title: Ripple Pushes RLUSD Deeper Into Banking With New Cross River Partnership
summary: New Jersey-based Cross River Bank has partnered with Ripple to bring RLUSD into its banking platform. The integration will support transactions on the XRP Ledger and allow customers to use the stablecoin alongside traditional payment methods.
